tool.name: Download MMseqs2 databases
tool.command:
#set $database_name = str($database).split('/')[-1] if '/' in str($database) else str($database)
mkdir -p '$out_file.extra_files_path'/'$database_name' && mmseqs databases '$database' '$out_file.extra_files_path'/'$database_name'/database 'tmp' --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && bash '$digest_script' '$out_file.extra_files_path/$database_name' '$dmjson' '$out_file' '$database_name'

configfiles.configfile:
set -euo pipefail database_dir="\$1" json_template="\$2" output="\$3" database_name="\$4"
database_digest=\$( cd "\$database_dir" manifest_digest=\$( find . -type f ! -path "./database.version" | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r relative_path; do file_digest=\$(sha256sum < "\$relative_path") file_digest=\${file_digest%% *} printf "%s\t%s\n" "\${relative_path#./}" "\$file_digest" done | sha256sum ) printf "%s\n" "\${manifest_digest%% *}" ) if [[ ! "\$database_digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}\$ ]]; then echo "Invalid MMseqs2 database digest: \$database_digest" >&2 exit 1 fi
download_date=\$(date "+%Y-%m-%d") if [[ ! "\$download_date" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\$ ]]; then echo "Invalid download date: \$download_date" >&2 exit 1 fi
database_path="\${database_dir%/*}/\${database_name}-sha256-\${database_digest}" mv "\$database_dir" "\$database_path" sed -e "s/__MMSEQS2_DATABASE_DIGEST__/\${database_digest}/g" \ -e "s/__MMSEQS2_DOWNLOAD_DATE__/\${download_date}/g" \ "\$json_template" > "\$output"

param.label: Type of Databases
param.option: Aminoacid databases that can be used for taxonomy
Nucleotide databases that can be used for taxonomy

param.name: database
param.label: MMseqs2 aminoacid databases that can be used for taxonomy
param.option: NR (Non-redundant protein sequences from GenPept, Swissprot, PIR, PDF, PDB, and NCBI RefSeq)

param.name: database
param.label: MMseqs2 nucleotide databases
param.option: NT (Partially non-redundant nucleotide sequences from all traditional divisions of GenBank, EMBL, and DDBJ excluding GSS, STS, PAT, EST, HTG, and WGS)

param.name: database
param.label: MMseqs2 nucleotide databases that can be used for taxonomy

tool.help:
This tool downloads databases that can be used with MMseqs2.
The installed database content digest identifies mutable upstream database aliases. The local download date is included only in the display name.
